coordinate_system.world: Right-handed, rink-centred, calibrated geometry only. See docs/geometry.md.
coordinate_system.origin: Centre of the inner board boundary (midpoint of its long and short extents) on the top surface of the ice sheet (z = 0).
coordinate_system.x_axis: +x along the rink's long axis, toward the goal that appears at the image-right end of stiga_se_fi_overhead (goal.E).
coordinate_system.y_axis: +y across the rink, toward the image-top long side of stiga_se_fi_overhead (boards reading Divello ... Coca-Cola ... Comfort).
coordinate_system.angles: Degrees in data. Rotation about +z, counter-clockwise seen from above; 0 deg = facing +x.
coordinate_system.image_pixels: Source-image pixels: u right, v down, origin at the image's top-left corner; pixel (i, j) covers [i, i+1) x [j, j+1). Pixel data never counts as millimetres without an image_to_world mapping.

assumptions.statement: The ice-side edge of the near-black strip at the base of the boards is the ice contact boundary.
assumptions.reason: The strip (median 14.8 px wide) widens in proportion to distance from the image centre (validation/05-evidence-check.json), as the lower part of a vertical board face does under a central camera; its ice-side edge is then the board base. Its material (trim or printed band) is not visible, and a small gap over the loose sheet cannot be excluded.
assumptions.replace_with: Close-up or measurement of the installed board base on the user's game.

assumptions.statement: Where the edge is hidden or disturbed, the boundary is interpolated (along the rays) between the nearest detected edge points on either side.
assumptions.reason: A few short stretches are disturbed by painted markings meeting the boards or fail the local consistency test; the neighbouring edge is continuous.

assumptions.statement: The official overhead views the ice plane nearly perpendicularly, so a similarity (no perspective) maps ice-plane pixels to the world.
assumptions.reason: Opposite traced sides are parallel within 0.22 deg; see validation/05-board-report.json. Elevated parts (board tops, screens, figures) do show perspective and are excluded.
assumptions.replace_with: Homography from a perpendicular overhead with scale markers in both directions.

assumptions.statement: The catalog playing length (approx. 845 mm) equals the traced inner boundary's long extent; one uniform scale is applied to both axes.
assumptions.reason: Only a preview scale is needed before calibration; the catalog does not say what the 845 mm spans.
assumptions.replace_with: Measured inner board length and width of the user's game.

assumptions.statement: The loose sheet in stiga_ca_bare_ice_sheet (older artwork) has the same slot layout as the installed sheet in stiga_se_fi_overhead; the two photographs are related by one planar homography.
assumptions.reason: Used only to locate slot ends hidden under figures in the overhead. Curve residuals after the fit are reported in validation/slots-report.json.
assumptions.replace_with: Overhead of the user's empty installed rink with scale markers.

assumptions.statement: For previews, each figure's fixture rotation axis runs along its visible slot centreline (offset [0, 0] mm) at ice level.
assumptions.reason: The real axis position relative to the slot is unknown; in the overhead several figures stand beside their slot, so an offset is likely.
assumptions.replace_with: Measured fixture-axis position (loose and installed figure, iteration 10 inputs).

assumptions.statement: Preview assets use the dimensions in preview_parameters wherever the physical value is unknown (board height and wall thickness, ice-sheet thickness, housing margin and depth).
assumptions.reason: No measurement of these exists; each entry's note records the photographic evidence behind the chosen preview value. The catalog overall lengths (960 vs approx. 940 mm) conflict and are NOT used to size the housing.
assumptions.replace_with: Measured board height, board wall thickness, ice-sheet thickness and housing outline of the user's game.

assumptions.statement: Skater mold scale k = 1.0866 mm per mold unit, fitted to four Sweden skaters on the official overhead (validation/players/overhead-fit.json) at the ASSUMED preview scale. The goalie no longer shares it: its scale k = 1.1422 comes from the user's measured height (54 mm).
assumptions.reason: No ruler measurement of a skater exists; the overhead is the only scaled view of the skaters (itself at the ASSUMED preview scale).
assumptions.replace_with: Ruler measurements of one skater: height (ice to helmet top), socket base diameter, blade length and heel offset from the socket axis.

assumptions.statement: Hidden or unresolved mold details are assumed: socket bore (3 x 2 x 3 mold units), blade and runner thickness (0.9 mold units skater, 2.4 goalie blade), stick wire radius (0.75), print fonts.
assumptions.reason: Not visible or not resolvable in the user's photos/videos.
assumptions.replace_with: Close-up measurements or scaled macro photos of the socket bore, blade and stick.
